name: SQLite savepoint with outer BEGIN
description: SQL from the SQLAlchemy explicit-BEGIN control. Releasing a nested savepoint leaves the outer transaction open, so the rollback removes the session row.
initial: CREATE TABLE entries (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT NOT NULL)

operations.note: Open the outer transaction before creating the savepoint.
The savepoint is nested inside the outer transaction.
Insert the session row inside the savepoint.
Releasing the nested savepoint leaves the write transaction open and autocommit off.
Roll back the outer transaction, including the insert from the released savepoint.

operations.sql: SELECT id, label FROM entries ORDER BY id
operations.note: B's first read sees the original row after the rollback.
